about: Luthier v3. Kept songs: 159 CoCoPops Billboard songs of 150 sung notes or more. Onsets in twelfths of a beat; a bar is 48.

650: the ease model.token: for each note after the first: (its pitch less the note before, clipped to -12..12) : (class of the gap from the note before, onsets in twelfths clipped to 1..96, by cut points 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 48, so 0..8)
650: the ease model.probability of a token given the two bef: p = [0.5 * c3(a,b,x)/c2(a,b) if c2(a,b) > 0] + [0.3 * c2(b,x)/c1(b) if c1(b) > 0] + 0.15 * c1(x)/N + 0.05/225, divided by the sum of the weights of the terms present; the song so far gives the same form from its own counts without the last term, used once it holds 8 tokens or more; ease probability = half the kept model and half the song so far (the kept model alone until then); bits = -log2

652 with 653 on dense lines (ruling of 1: 653 sets the line's entry and its breath; the breath is a least distance from the last onset to the next line's first. 652's whole bars are chosen to fit inside them. For the line's last bar, take a kept bar whose last onset lies within an eighth (6 twelfths) of the last onset the kept line of 653 had, where one fits; otherwise the kept bar that fits and ends latest. The span follows the bars. 653's span test is read on lines under 5.5 notes to the slot's bar; on dense lines the span is printed beside the kept quartiles and not tested.

655: by line, for reference only (NOT th.how: for each kept line (three notes or more, two gaps or more, a line and its next in one section), the share of ITS OWN gaps (successive onsets within the line, in twelfths of a beat) that are exactly a sixteenth (3), eighth (6), dotted eighth (9), quarter (12), dotted quarter (18), half (24); then the percentile of that share across the kept lines of the cell (notes over the slot's bars)

655: THE CAP. A gap class's share of one.how: for each kept song, the gaps of all its lines in the cell pooled (songs with 12 such gaps or more), and the share of those gaps that are exactly a sixteenth, eighth, dotted eighth, quarter, dotted quarter, half; then the percentile of that share across kept songs. This is the cap of fix 655: a palette is one song's mix, so it is capped by what one kept song's lines of the cell have, not by what one line has.

650: the per-note reading.how: for every fifth note of a build (from the fifth, stopping four from the end): the note as sung against each neighbour one to four semitones above or below that lies in the song's scale; each scored by the summed ease bits of the three tokens the note touches (the move into it, the move out of it, and the next), the song so far being the tokens before the move into the note; 'recurs' = how many of the three-token figures containing the note are sung elsewhere in the song
